package_info.why_malicious: N/A – Frogbot is not malicious. It is a security tool designed to scan pull requests for vulnerable dependencies using JFrog Xray and report findings directly in the git UI. No evidence of malicious behavior is present in the provided report.

detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: No detection required. Frogbot is a legitimate security automation tool that integrates with git repositories to scan for vulnerable dependencies and report results in pull requests. No malicious behavior or indicators are present in the provided information.
